notes: Five branches joined by «ح»; «كلهم عن شعبة، بهذا الإسناد» is written once after them, so it is the shared tail.
«يعني ابن الحارث» is a gloss on خالد and is left out.
«محمد بن، حاتم» keeps the stray comma as written in the text.
The last remark «وقال ابن حاتم في حديثه عن يحيى، ورخص» repeats names already in branch B and only adds a wording: left out.
